\begin{proposition}[Auxiliary symbol witness and Fourier-complex SDR]
For the Lorentzian conformal cylinder, the local
ordinary-derivative tensor--tensor--vector BV Fourier complex
contracts from $66$ to the $30$-component metric BV core.
Its exact four-row Fourier symbols obey
\[Q^2=0,\qquad QW_{\rm aux}+W_{\rm aux}Q=P_{\rm aux},\qquad
W_{\rm aux}^{\sharp}=W_{\rm aux},\]
and every diagonal block has scalar metric principal symbol.

The trace/Weyl and nonminimal doublets reattach as

not assert the curved lower-order chain-map and Green-witness
